title: Risk Management Considerations Related to the Use of Distributed Ledger Technology
summary: On 16 April 2024, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) issued a circular titled 'Risk management considerations related to the use of distributed ledger technology.' As its own title states, the circular sets out considerations for Authorized Institutions to take into account when using distributed ledger technology (DLT).
why_it_matters: For a newcomer, this circular shows HKMA extending its digital-asset guidance to the underlying technology itself, not just specific products like stablecoins or staking, as part of how Hong Kong's banking regulator oversees banks adopting blockchain-based infrastructure.
